description: 2 of 7 captured lines carry observer.ingress.interface.name=eth0, rule.category=Web Application Attack.
origin: Counted over the captured lines by corpus/heldout_scenarios.py. Nothing was injected: the events are the samples, unaltered, and expected_hits is how many of them already carry these values.
why_this_catches_semantic_errors: The query filters on the ECS fields, not on the source keys. A mapping that puts the right value in the wrong field is schema-valid, indexes cleanly and passes V1, V2 and V3; the count comes back 0 and only V4 notices.
